english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something spreading through air, water, or another medium, whether it is made to spread or spreads on its own.

examples.english: The disinfectant can slowly diffuse through the water.
examples.traditional: 啲消毒藥水可以喺水入面慢慢擴散開。
